import subprocess, pathlib, json, time, csv, argparse
out=pathlib.Path('artifacts/lean-routing');base=['kubectl','--context','homelab','-n','maximus-perf-routing','exec','measure']
def cmd(container,*args):return base+['-c',container,'--',*args]
def read(container,*args):return subprocess.check_output(cmd(container,*args),text=True)
def stats():
 return json.loads(read('server','python3','-c',"import json,os,pathlib;pid=pathlib.Path('/work/server.pid').read_text().strip();s=pathlib.Path('/proc/'+pid+'/stat').read_text().split(')')[1].split();print(json.dumps(dict(ticks=int(s[11])+int(s[12]),rss=int(s[21])*os.sysconf('SC_PAGE_SIZE'),hz=os.sysconf('SC_CLK_TCK'))))"))
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--protocol',default='h2');p.add_argument('--vus',type=int,default=64);p.add_argument('--variants',default='before,lookup');p.add_argument('--label',required=True);p.add_argument('--repeats',type=int,default=5);p.add_argument('--body',default='1024');p.add_argument('--rate',default='0');p.add_argument('--path',default='/echo');p.add_argument('--duration',default='35s');a=p.parse_args()
rows=[];variants=a.variants.split(',')
for n in range(a.repeats):
 for v in variants[n%len(variants):]+variants[:n%len(variants)]:
  key=f'{a.label}-{v}-{n}'
  read('server','sh','-c',f'{"MAXIMUS_CERT=/work/cert.pem MAXIMUS_KEY=/work/key.pem" if a.protocol == "h2" else ""} PROTOCOL={a.protocol} WORKERS=1 /work/results/pin 4 /work/results/server-{v} maximus >/work/server.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/work/server.pid')
  try:
   for _ in range(50):
    if 'ready' in read('server','cat','/work/server.log'):break
    time.sleep(.1)
   else:raise RuntimeError('server not ready')
   before=stats()
   env=['env',f'PROTOCOL={a.protocol}',f'PATHNAME={a.path}',f'BODY_BYTES={a.body}',f'DURATION={a.duration}',f'VUS={a.vus}','SSL_CERT_FILE=/work/cert.pem',f'RESULT=/work/results/{key}.json']
   if a.rate!='0':env.append(f'RATE={a.rate}')
   t=time.monotonic()
   with (out/f'{key}.log').open('w') as f:r=subprocess.run(cmd('client',*env,'/work/results/pin','80','k6','run','--quiet','/work/load.js'),stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
   elapsed=time.monotonic()-t;after=stats()
   s=json.loads(read('server','cat',f'/work/results/{key}.json'));(out/f'{key}.json').write_text(json.dumps(s))
   m=s['metrics'];val=lambda k,f,default=0:m.get(k,{}).get('values',{}).get(f,default)
   count=val('http_reqs','count');assert count==val('starts','count')==val('iterations','count') and count>0
   row=dict(phase=a.label,variant=v,repeat=n,path=a.path,body=int(a.body),rate=int(a.rate),requests=count,rps=val('http_reqs','rate'),cpu_us=(after['ticks']-before['ticks'])/before['hz']*1e6/count,steady_requests=val('steady_requests','count'),p99_ms=val('steady_latency','p(99)'),p999_ms=val('steady_latency','p(99.9)'),rss=after['rss'],failures=val('http_req_failed','passes'),checks_failed=val('checks','fails'),dropped=val('dropped_iterations','count'),exit=r.returncode,wall_seconds=elapsed)
   rows.append(row)
   with (out/f'{a.label}.csv').open('w') as f:w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(row),lineterminator='\n');w.writeheader();w.writerows(rows)
   print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
  finally:read('server','sh','-c','kill $(cat /work/server.pid); sleep 0.2')

pod_yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: maximus-perf-routing
  labels:
    purpose: temporary-maximus-benchmark
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: measure
  namespace: maximus-perf-routing
spec:
  nodeSelector:
    kubernetes.io/hostname: homelab-01
  restartPolicy: Never
  activeDeadlineSeconds: 10800
  volumes:
    - name: work
      emptyDir: {}
  containers:
    - name: server
      image: rust:1.96-bookworm
      command: [sh, -c, 'mkdir -p /work/results; chmod 777 /work/results; sleep 10800']
      resources:
        requests: {cpu: '2', memory: 4Gi}
        limits: {cpu: '2', memory: 6Gi}
      securityContext:
        seccompProfile: {type: Unconfined}
      volumeMounts:
        - {name: work, mountPath: /work}
    - name: client
      image: grafana/k6:1.6.0
      command: [sh, -c, 'sleep 10800']
      resources:
        requests: {cpu: '2', memory: 1Gi}
        limits: {cpu: '2', memory: 2Gi}
      volumeMounts:
        - {name: work, mountPath: /work}
measurement_notes: CPU is process user+system ticks divided by completed requests, including warmup; excludes separately scheduled kernel work.
k6 closed-loop runs are client/workload regression screens, not saturated server-capacity measurements.
Fixed-rate starts at 100/s, ramps five seconds, then holds the target. Latency excludes the first five seconds. Whole-run RPS includes the ramp.
Every valid row requires positive equal starts, iterations and HTTP response counts; all completed bodies/statuses/protocols are checked. Dropped arrivals fail the trial and remain in the CSV.
RSS is one post-run sample, not peak memory.
Bootstrap uses 20,000 paired resamples of mean log ratios with seed 73051. Small samples and shared-host noise limit inference; intervals do not prove universal parity.
Cold focused probe uses allocation counts only; zero-iteration timing is intentionally omitted.
H1 iterator and line-scan experiments are not retained. Focused bundle timings are exploratory, not timings of the final entire framework.
Huffman follow-up sample array index is repetition 0 through 29; final is the isolated candidate decoder.
